description: Aérodromes et bases ULM dans le Loiret - Département du Loiret is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département du Loiret. Localisation ponctuelle des aérodromes et des bases ULM (Ultra Léger Motorisé) du Loiret. Contexte de collecte Méthode de collecte La couche ponctuelle a été créé à partir de la couche surfacique AERODROME de la BDTOPO® de l'IGN. Une sélection a été réalisée pour garder uniquement les 5 aérodromes et les 2 bases ULM du Loiret. Coverage: Département du Loiret. The publisher named on the listing is Département du Loiret. Its keywords include reseaux-de-transport, mobilite, transports, infrastructures, aerodrome. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV, SHAPEFILE, ZIP. The listing shows 2025-07-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
